items.control_name: Enforce Immutable Vault Protection on Azure Backup Recovery Services Vaults
items.description: Recovery Services and Backup vaults must enable Immutability (WORM) and Soft Delete (14+ days) to protect against ransomware backup deletion.
items.current_value: Vault 'rsv-prod-core' has ImmutabilityState = 'Locked' and SoftDelete = Enabled
items.recommended_value: ImmutabilityState = 'Locked' across all production backup vaults
items.remediation_notes: Verify backup restore points across paired geographic regions.

items.control_name: Configure Automated Forensic Snapshot Isolation Runbooks in Azure Automation
items.description: Incident response workflows must use Azure Automation runbooks to automatically snapshot and isolate VM disks upon Sentinel/Defender critical alert.
items.current_value: Runbook 'IR-Forensic-Disk-Snapshot' linked to Defender Critical Alerts
items.recommended_value: Automated forensic runbook active across 100% of production subscriptions
items.remediation_notes: Test forensic snapshot automation during quarterly incident response drills.

items.control_name: Enforce Azure Site Recovery (ASR) with Customer Managed Keys for Critical VMs
items.description: Tier-0 VMs replicated via Azure Site Recovery must encrypt replication cache and target disks using Key Vault Customer Managed Keys.
items.current_value: ASR replication active for 10 Tier-0 VMs; encryption uses Microsoft-managed key
items.recommended_value: ASR replication encrypted with Customer Managed Key (CMK)
items.remediation_notes: Assign Key Vault CMK to Azure Site Recovery replication vault.

items.control_name: Enforce Emergency Break-Glass Accounts with Monitored Sign-in Alerts
items.description: Two emergency break-glass Entra ID global admin accounts must exist without Conditional Access MFA dependencies, monitored 24/7 by Azure Sentinel alerts.
items.current_value: 2 break-glass accounts configured; Sentinel alert 'Alert-BreakGlass-Usage' active
items.recommended_value: 2 monitored break-glass accounts with quarterly password rotation in fireproof safe
items.remediation_notes: Verify break-glass accounts are excluded from federation (native cloud-only accounts).
